blocks.title: Reported model
blocks.text: Broadcom designs, develops and supplies semiconductor and semiconductor-based solutions and infrastructure software. It reports two segments: semiconductor solutions, including semiconductor product lines and IP licensing, and infrastructure software, including private cloud, mainframe software, cybersecurity, enterprise software and FC SAN.

evidence.quote: We have two reportable segments: semiconductor solutions and infrastructure software.

blocks.title: Revenue presentation
blocks.text: Revenue is reported as products and subscriptions and services. In the fiscal quarter ended August 2, 2026, $3,465 million of upfront software license revenue was included in products revenue.

evidence.quote: we included upfront license revenue of $3,465 million

blocks.title: Semiconductor portfolio and uses
blocks.text: The filing describes digital and mixed-signal devices, network interface cards, modules, switches and subsystems. Applications include data centers, servers, networking and connectivity equipment, storage, home connectivity, set-top boxes, broadband access, telecommunications, wireless devices and base stations, factory automation, power generation and alternative energy, and electronic displays.

evidence.quote: enterprise and artificial intelligence (“AI”) data centers, servers and networking and connectivity equipment

blocks.title: Infrastructure software and FC SAN
blocks.text: Infrastructure and security software supports private cloud, hybrid cloud and edge environments. Broadcom also offers FC SAN products and related software.

evidence.quote: modernize, optimize, and secure the most complex private cloud, hybrid cloud and edge environments

blocks.title: Reported demand
blocks.text: Management reported unprecedented demand for custom AI accelerators (XPUs) and AI networking solutions from customers, including leading frontier AI labs, attributing it to demand for AI compute.

evidence.quote: We see unprecedented demand for our custom AI accelerators or XPUs and AI networking solutions from our customers, including the leading frontier AI labs

blocks.title: Documented customer and channel facts
blocks.text: The filing identifies distributors, original equipment manufacturer customers, contract manufacturers, channel partners and software customers in its description of shipment or delivery locations. It does not name individual customers in the supplied excerpt.

evidence.quote: specified by our distributors, original equipment manufacturer customers, contract manufacturers, channel partners, or software customers

blocks.title: Inferred buyer archetypes
blocks.text: Potential buyer archetypes suggested by the disclosed applications include data-center and server operators, networking and connectivity equipment providers, and enterprises buying infrastructure software. These are application-based archetypes, not named or confirmed customers.

evidence.quote: Our customers rely on our infrastructure and security software solutions to modernize, optimize, and secure

blocks.title: Demand and committed performance obligations
blocks.text: Management described the AI XPV platform as enabling more than 20 gigawatts of compute capacity through 2028. Remaining performance obligations under certain multi-year contracts were approximately $179.2 billion as of August 2, 2026; the filing cautions that this amount is not indicative of future-period revenue.

blocks.title: AI XPV financial exposure
blocks.text: The maximum potential undiscounted Backstop liability upon deployment of all AI racks was approximately $29 billion. The filing states that its fair value was not material and no amounts had been paid.

evidence.quote: Our maximum potential liability under the Backstop upon the deployment of all AI racks, on an undiscounted basis, was approximately $29 billion.

blocks.text: The filing notes that legal proceedings and regulatory matters are inherently uncertain and that material adverse outcomes are possible.

evidence.quote: the outcomes of such proceedings are inherently uncertain, with material adverse outcomes possible.
